div.div: Future implementation content This page is provided to show the expected direction of future implementation work. It is not part of the proposed material for evaluation in this publication; mappings, target artefacts and profiling details are expected to evolve in subsequent iterations of this guide.

Yellow row/cells: In this ballot publication, some row/cells of the mapping table have been left in yellow to indicate areas requiring further review or refinement; including feedback from the Xt-EHR joint action (see note above). These highlights will be addressed in subsequent updates to ensure accuracy and completeness of the mappings.

body.p: This page explains how elements from the Radiotherapy logical model are expressed in the FHIR Resource ProcedureRadiotherapyEuCcm resource used by this Implementation Guide. The logical model describes the whole radiotherapy course as a single summary, which is why it is mapped to a Procedure with a performed period (comparable to the mCODE Radiotherapy Course Summary) rather than to an EpisodeOfCare, which in FHIR represents a care-management relationship and not a treatment.

tr.td: Here the reference to a PatientEuCcm must be made.
Here the reference to a CancerConditionAtDiagnosisEuCcm must be made.
Here the ObservationClinicalCancerProgression can be referenced, if the radiotherapy is delivered in response to a progression.
Extension CancerTreatmentIntent; the code must stem from the Cancer Treatment Intent value set (SNOMED CT curative / palliative).
Start date of the radiotherapy course.
End date of the radiotherapy course, if available. While the course is still ongoing the end is absent and status is in-progress.
Anatomical site(s) targeted by the radiotherapy.
Extension CancerTreatmentSetting; the SNOMED CT codes of the Cancer Treatment Setting value set still need review against the model choices (alone, neoadjuvant, adjuvant, concomitant).
Fixed to SNOMED CT 1287742003 "Radiotherapy (procedure)"; the logical model has no type element for radiotherapy.
